home.title: Tattoo Studio in Bad Nauheim | KurstadtTattoo
home.description: KurstadtTattoo, your tattoo studio in Bad Nauheim near Frankfurt: realistic portraits and fine line work by Patrick Wolf. Reopening on 1 December 2026 at Friedrich-Ebert-Platz 1A.

hero.heading: Tattoo studio in Bad Nauheim for realistic portraits and fine lines
hero.intro: KurstadtTattoo is the tattoo studio of Patrick Wolf in the Wetterau region, right next to Friedberg and just outside Frankfurt. You bring your idea or your own design, and we plan the piece together with you.

art.title: What kind of tattoos does KurstadtTattoo create?
art.intro: Our focus is realistic portraits and fine lines. We also tattoo colour pieces, black and grey, blackwork, lettering and ornamental work.

styles.title: Realism and portraits
styles.text: Animals, people and memories, put on skin with an eye for detail.

styles.title: Fine line
styles.text: Delicate designs with fine lines, from a dragonfly to lettering.

styles.title: Colour, black and grey, blackwork
styles.text: From colourful designs to ornamental work in black.

styles.title: Your own design
styles.text: You bring your own artwork, we turn it into your individual tattoo.

styles.title: Finishing
styles.text: We finish tattoos that were started in another studio.

hygiene.title: How important is hygiene at KurstadtTattoo?
hygiene.intro: Since the studio was founded, hygiene has been one of the values we care about most, together with quality and your satisfaction.
hygiene.text: Everyone here works to the same standards: hygiene, professionalism and customer satisfaction. Clean work includes the time after your session. We explain how to care for your tattoo while it heals and offer aftercare.
hygiene.imageAlt: Patrick Wolf tattooing a forearm, wearing black gloves, with a covered tattoo machine
hygiene.careTitle: What to keep in mind while it heals
care: Wash your hands thoroughly before you touch the tattoo.
Remove the film after the first few hours, clean the area with lukewarm water and mild soap and pat it dry.
Apply a thin layer of healing ointment.
Avoid direct sunlight, sunbeds and swimming in pools or lakes until the skin has healed.
If you notice strong redness, swelling or pus, please see a doctor straight away.

process.title: How does getting a tattoo at KurstadtTattoo work?
process.intro: In four steps: a call, a consultation on design and placement, your session in the studio and aftercare. Before the first line is tattooed, we plan the design together with you.

artists.title: Who tattoos at KurstadtTattoo?
artists.lead: Patrick Wolf runs KurstadtTattoo and is our specialist for realistic portraits and fine lines.
artists.text: With his eye for detail and a steady hand he turns memories and ideas into art on skin: the portrait of a dog, lettering for the family or a delicate dragonfly.
artists.imageAlt: Patrick Wolf in sunglasses with crossed, tattooed arms in front of the neon wall with the KurstadtTattoo logo

booking.question: How do I book an appointment at KurstadtTattoo?
booking.answer: We take appointment requests by phone at {phone}. For other questions you can email us at {email}.

ownDesign.question: Can I bring my own design?
ownDesign.answer: Yes. You can bring your own design, and we turn it into a tattoo that matches your wishes. Photos and memories, for a portrait for example, are a good starting point too.

finishing.question: Do you finish tattoos that were started somewhere else?
finishing.answer: Yes, we do. Bring the unfinished tattoo to your consultation and we will talk about how to complete it.

care.question: How do I look after my new tattoo?
care.answer: Clean the tattoo regularly and apply a thin layer of healing ointment. Wash your hands thoroughly first, avoid direct sunlight and do not scratch.

removal.question: Can I have a tattoo removed?
removal.answer: Tattoos are removed by laser and fade gradually, usually over several sessions. Dermatologists offer this treatment. We are happy to give you information about it.

reopening.question: When does the new studio open?
reopening.answer: On 1 December 2026 at Friedrich-Ebert-Platz 1A, 61231 Bad Nauheim. Until then the studio is closed.

steps.title: Call and request an appointment
steps.text: We take appointment requests by phone. Tell us briefly which design you have in mind and where it should go.

steps.title: Consultation on design and placement
steps.text: We plan your tattoo closely with you until it matches what you have in mind. Feel free to bring your own design, photos or ideas.

steps.title: Your session in the studio
steps.text: The agreed design is tattooed with care and an eye for detail, in a pleasant and safe atmosphere.

steps.title: Care and aftercare
steps.text: You get instructions on how to care for the tattoo while it heals. If you have questions, we are there for you and offer aftercare.
